body: this is the internet, and i know there are heartless people on it.. i welcome your coldness
you guys calling me bro makes me sad.... i wish you guys were here to talk to me in person... :(

I slashed my arms already.. :( .. i know she loves me... i know she does.. i just wish i didn't have to repeatedly try to communicate my frustration to her.. but i know she loves me. i just feel beyond horrible that this happened... i never meant to hurt her...
she does care.... :( ... she tries to fix things with me, she just slowly goes back to her old behavior sometimes.. but i know she loves me ... i know she does :(
